run_race_preprocessing: run the Race dataset preprocessing script to generate k-shot data for middle and high school subsets
create_race_dataset: create a Race dataset instance for a given subset like middle or high school
review_get_choices_and_answer_string: review the get_choices_and_answer_string method that extracts choices and answer strings from a RACE datapoint
summarize_map_hf_dataset_to_list: summarize the map_hf_dataset_to_list method that converts HuggingFace RACE dataset splits into input-answer tuples
test_load_dataset: test the load_dataset method that loads the RACE dataset from HuggingFace for a specified subset
